title: Revenue Operations Manager - Demand Generation
description:

SoSafe is a leading human risk management platform designed to transform the "human factor" from a security vulnerability into a proactive layer of defense. We focus on driving measurable behavior change and quantifiable risk reduction for our global customers.

YOUR ROLE: ARCHITECT OF OUR DEMAND ENGINE

As Revenue Operations Manager for Demand Generation, you will own the end-to-end operational architecture connecting Marketing, our SDR organization, and Account Executives into a single, cohesive pipeline creation engine. Rather than viewing demand in isolated channel silos, you will design the infrastructure, data routing, and AI-native automations that fuel both Inbound and Outbound motions.

You will ensure that every inbound handoff is seamless and that outbound prospecting is hyper-targeted toward our highest-converting opportunities; directly counteracting broader SaaS industry trends where late-stage conversion rates have tightened..

- Operationalize Our 2026 ICP & Intent Signals: Hardwire our target ICP criteria, EU mid-market organizations with 500-5,000 employees in regulated industries (Manufacturing, Healthcare, Finance, Public Sector), into our lead scoring and routing logic. Use Clay and Zapier to enrich accounts based on Microsoft 365 tech stack indicators and regulatory pressure signals (e.g., NIS2, DORA compliance deadlines).

- Supercharge SDR & AE Outbounding: Build automated prospecting workflows that allow SDRs and AEs to discover, enrich, and add target ICP contacts into Salesloft cadences with one click.

- Introduce AI-Native Lead Generation: Partner with our dedicated GTM Engineer to implement cutting-edge AI use cases across the top of the funnel. Drive automated lead enrichment, intent-based account prioritization, and automated meeting scheduling to maximize representative output per hour.

- Pipeline Health & Target Setting: Partner with Marketing Leadership, Sales Leadership, and the Revenue Operations team to set MQL/SQL targets, track funnel velocity, and maintain a robust unweighted pipeline coverage ratio of 3-4x across all territories.

- Experience: 5+ years of professional experience in Revenue Operations, Marketing Operations, or Sales Operations within a high-growth B2B SaaS environment.

- Holistic GTM Perspective: You view demand generation as a single team sport. You understand how marketing campaigns, SDR outbound cadences, AE self-prospecting, and channel partner motions interact to create a pipeline.

- Tech Stack Mastery: Advanced experience administering and integrating HubSpot (Marketing Suite), Salesforce (SFDC), and Salesloft. Experience with data orchestrators like Clay, Zapier, and forecasting platforms like Clari is highly preferred.

- Data-Driven by heart: Fluency across core SaaS funnel metrics, including MQL-to-SQL Conversion, Cost per Opportunity, Win Rates by Channel, CAC Payback, and Pipeline Velocity.

- Process Engineering Mindset: You excel at translating complex go-to-market strategies into automated, fail-safe system logic with clear SLA governance between Marketing, SDRs, and AEs.

Our platform spans web content management, curriculum and catalog management, student engagement and lifelong learning - giving more than 1,700 colleges and universities the infrastructure they need to support the entire learner-to-earner lifecycle and deliver personalized, scalable experiences.

We partner with the education community to create new pathways for learning and opportunity, reimagining how institutions serve the modern learner and shape the future of education.

Our purpose - our north star - is to empower institutions to confidently serve and support the modern learner.

This mission and purpose come to life through how we show up every day:

• We exist to create empowerment through education.

• We lead with honesty and empathy.

• We make the complex feel possible.

title: Director, Enterprise Customer Success Management
description:
ABOUT CODERABBIT

CodeRabbit is the leading AI code review platform, trusted by more than 17,000 customers and 150,000 open-source projects, conducting over 2 million code reviews each week. We build the symbiotic partnership between developers and AI that makes shipping fast software safe again, reviewing every pull request, IDE change, and CLI commit so teams can move quickly without breaking things.

 

We are a fast-moving, well-funded company, fresh off a $143M Series C at a $1.5B valuation - building Agentic Change Management, the control layer for software changes created by humans and agents. As AI writes more of the world's code, the bottleneck moves from implementation to judgment and helping human judgment scale is exactly the problem we exist to solve.

ROLE OVERVIEW

At CodeRabbit, we seek an exceptional, passionate Director of Customer Success Management to join our growing customer success organization in the Americas theater. Reporting to the VP of Customer Success, you will ensure our customers realize value with our AI-powered code review platform. You will lead and develop the organization responsible for the success and happiness of customers - across enterprises and startups. This leader will shape and scale the post-sales strategy and operations, helping customers derive maximal value from their engagement.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

1. Hiring and developing a Customer Success Management team

2. Own forecasting for renewals, expansion, and churn risk across the book of business, delivering accurate NRR and GRR commits to the executive team

3. Overseeing the customer journey from onboarding to production scaling

4. Build strong, meaningful relationships with our customers and proactively seek to understand their business objectives and expectations

5. Building playbooks and knowledge bases

6. Own a book of business to include renewals and expansion opportunities

7. Become a product expert and understand all components of CodeRabbit

8. Educate customers on the best product usage to ensure they maximize their value

9. Champion customer needs internally, leveraging your customer knowledge to advocate for them and influence the product roadmap

10. Relentlessly focus on solving customer challenges by effectively communicating specific benefits and best practices of CodeRabbit

11. Own customer-facing communications to ensure a professional and concise message

12. Partner cross-functionally to advocate for customer needs

13. Develop and present periodic reviews to customer leadership

QUALIFICATIONS

Great candidates often have these qualifications:

1. At least 10+ years of experience in customer success, account management, or a similar role, with at least 5 years in a leadership role

2. Demonstrated success building and scaling customer-facing teams in a high-growth technology company

3. Technical competency to understand CodeRabbit’s software and build strong relationships with highly technical prospects and key business stakeholders

4. Strong knowledge of the customer success space, including experience with negotiations and procurement processes

5. Customer Obsession: a passion to deliver a high-quality customer experience and a curiosity to help solve their problems

6. Comfortable and proficient with various sales methodologies such as MEDDPICC, SPICED, and Command of Message

7. Ability to establish trust at the CxO level as well as with software development practitioners

8. Familiarity with modern software development practices, version control systems, and the software development ecosystem, e.g. Git, GitHub, CI/CD, VS Code, Cursor

9. Excellent communication skills: business fluency in spoken and written English

10. Ability to travel about 25% of the time to meet with customers

“NICE TO HAVE”

Financial security shouldn’t be a privilege. Yet, Americans carry $1.26 trillion in credit card debt¹, nearly one in four has no emergency savings², and only 46% of households reported retirement-account savings³. Rocket Money 's mission is to meaningfully improve people's financial prosperity for millions of people.
Few companies combine Rocket Money ’s reach, member trust, and understanding of people’s financial lives. Our vision: money that works for you, without making you work for it. With advances in automation and AI, we can go beyond helping members understand their finances to helping them improve their financial health, paying down debt, saving and growing their money automatically.⁠
We’re looking for a Senior Product Manager to build a new investing product from 0→1, then grow and scale it into a core part of Rocket Money ’s future. With end-to-end ownership and direct access to senior leadership, you’ll have the reach of an established platform, the impact of a small team, and the opportunity to improve millions of financial lives.

Together, you’ll uncover meaningful member needs, test the hardest assumptions, and build a simple, trustworthy experience. You’ll shape product direction, make clear prioritization decisions, and own outcomes from discovery through launch and scale.
The opportunity goes beyond launching another product: you’ll help make Rocket Money a place members turn to not just to manage today’s finances, but to build their financial future. What you build will give members new reasons to stay and grow with us, and help shape Rocket Money ’s next chapter.

Success means building a product members value and a business that grows, not simply shipping features.

title: Remote - HCC / Risk Adjustment Medical Coders (6783)
description:
Job Title: HCC / Risk Adjustment Medical Coder
Location : Remote, US
Shift Hours: Applicant should be available to work from 6 AM to 6 PM EST.
Pay Rate: $18-$22/hr.
Candidates must be available to commit to a minimum of 20 hours per week, Monday through Friday. Preference will be given to candidates who can commit to a full-time schedule of 40 hours per week.
Important : This position follows a Bring Your Own Device (BYOD) policy. Candidates must have a Windows-based laptop/desktop with Windows Professional Edition (Windows Pro) and a reliable high-speed internet connection. Systems running Windows Home Edition are not compatible with the security requirements for this role.
Job Summary: We are seeking experienced Medical Coders with a strong background in Risk Adjustment and Hierarchical Condition Category (HCC) coding. The ideal candidate will hold at least a CPC or CCS certification from AHIMA or AAPC, and higher-level certifications are highly desirable. As a Medical Coder specializing in Risk Adjustment/HCC, you will play a crucial role in ensuring accurate and compliant coding for our healthcare organization.

Key Responsibilities:

• Review and accurately code medical records and encounters for diagnoses and procedures related to Risk Adjustment and HCC coding guidelines.

• Ensure coding is consistent with ICD-10-CM, CMS-HCC, and other relevant coding guidelines.

• Validate and ensure the completeness, accuracy, and integrity of coded data.

• Identify and resolve coding discrepancies or discrepancies between clinical documentation and diagnosis coding.

• Stay up-to-date with the latest coding guidelines, rules, and regulations related to Risk Adjustment and HCC coding.

• Adhere to all compliance and HIPAA regulations to maintain data security and patient confidentiality.

• Collaborate with healthcare providers, physicians, and other team members to clarify documentation and resolve coding queries.

• Participate in coding education and training programs to enhance coding skills and knowledge.

• Prepare and submit reports related to coding activities, coding accuracy, and any coding-related issues or trends.

• Assist in internal and external coding audits to ensure the quality and compliance of coding practices.

• Identify opportunities for process improvement and efficiency in the coding process.

• Offer suggestions to enhance coding documentation and accuracy.

Requirements
Qualifications:

• Minimum CPC or CCS certification from AHIMA or AAPC is required. Higher-level certifications such as CRC (Certified Risk Adjustment Coder) is a significant advantage. CPC-A (Apprentice) certification will not be considered for this position.

• Minimum one to two years of experience in Risk Adjustment and HCC coding in a healthcare setting.

• Strong knowledge of ICD-10-CM coding guidelines and CMS-HCC risk adjustment methodology.

• Familiarity with electronic health record (EHR) systems and coding software.

• Excellent attention to detail, analytical skills, and ability to work independently.

• Strong communication and interpersonal skills for collaboration with medical professionals and team members.

• Understanding of compliance and confidentiality regulations, including HIPAA.

About the Opportunity
DMI , LLC is seeking a Scrum Master to run the delivery cadence on a ServiceNow service management program for a customer on Capitol Hill. The program runs in two tracks from award: a six-week assessment and planning phase producing a current-state baseline, future-state model, and prioritized roadmap, and concurrent Agile Scrum delivery of a customer-approved ServiceNow backlog, followed by iterative implementation against the roadmap.
The Scrum Master owns the sprint rhythm: facilitation of every ceremony, removal of impediments, coaching of the team and the customer Product Owner, and coordination of Agile delivery with release management, testing, deployment, and organizational change management. This is a facilitation and coaching role inside a formal Government acceptance process, not a project administration role.

Impediments and Dependencies

• Coordinate Agile development with release management, testing, production deployment, and organizational change management activities.

•
Team Health and Improvement

• Coach the team toward greater self-management, accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement, including identifying and addressing behaviors or practices that impede delivery.

• Report observed velocity and sprint outcomes for the weekly status report, so the customer decides on pace with evidence.

• Run retrospectives whose actions feed the backlog and the continuous-improvement process the customer reviews and approves.

This role conducts detailed audits of filings, reports, correspondence, and supporting documentation to verify compliance and identify discrepancies, omissions, or inconsistencies. Bachelor’s Degree Required 5+ years of Default/Foreclosure/Title knowledge Required BKFS, Tempo and, Equator experience highly preferred Proficiency with Excel and other Microsoft Office Products Ability to manage and prioritize large caseload Ability to type at least 60 WPM

Must provide excellent customer service to internal and external customers Identifies and solves issues in a timely manner. Vous ferez partie d'une PME belge en pleine croissance, où l’initiative et le développement personnel sont encouragés. title: Revenue Operations Lead (x/f/m)
description:
Gemeinsam gestalten wir die Gesundheitsversorgung der Zukunft

Wir suchen Dich als Revenue Operations Lead für unser Revenue Operations Team in Berlin. Doctolib bietet Arztpraxen in Deutschland ein Portfolio, das von Terminmanagement und Patientenkommunikation über KI-Assistenten für Telefon und Dokumentation bis zur vollständigen Praxissoftware reicht, und vertreibt es über mehrere Sales Motions parallel: Field Sales, Inside Sales, Customer Success und einen jungen Partnerkanal. Revenue Operations bündelt die kommerzielle Planung und Steuerung für alle Sales Motions, von Zielen und Kapazität über Pipeline und Performance bis zu Pricing und Packaging.

Als Revenue Operations Lead verantwortest Du die kommerzielle Steuerung von Inside Sales, vom Neugeschäft bis zu Upsell und Retention im Bestand, und bist dort die Ansprechperson für das Leadership, wenn aus Zahlen Entscheidungen werden. Zugleich übernimmst Du Themen, die über alle Motions laufen, etwa gemeinsame KPI-Definitionen oder die jährliche Planungsrunde, und gestaltest unsere Go-to-Market-Strategie mit: in welche Segmente, Motions und Kanäle wir investieren.

Nach sechs Monaten steuert Inside Sales auf einer gemeinsamen Zahlenbasis mit festen Routinen, die nächste Planungsrunde mit Zielen und Kapazität steht auf nachvollziehbaren Regeln, und mindestens eine wiederkehrende Steuerungsaufgabe läuft KI-gestützt.

Deine Aufgaben

• Performance Management: Du steuerst mit dem Inside-Sales-Leadership die Performance über den gesamten Funnel, erkennst Abweichungen vom Plan früh und machst daraus konkrete Maßnahmen

• Planung, Ziele & Kapazität: Du übersetzt den kommerziellen Plan in Ziele, Gebiete und Kapazität pro Team und Seller:in und passt sie im Quartal nach klaren Regeln an, wenn sich Headcount oder Markt verändern

• Incentives: Du gestaltest mit dem Sales Leadership die Logik der variablen Vergütung, damit Seller:innen für das bezahlt werden, woran das Geschäft gemessen wird

• Go-to-Market & Wachstumspotenziale: Du identifizierst, welche Segmente, Sales Motions und Kanäle Investitionen verdienen, rechnest durch, was ein Neukunde je Motion kostet, und baust den Business Case hinter einer Entscheidung

• Business Reviews & Follow-up: Du bereitest Business Reviews vor, führst sie mit dem Leadership und bleibst dran, bis aus jedem Befund eine Entscheidung mit klarer Verantwortung geworden ist

• KI als Hebel für operative Exzellenz: Du automatisierst wiederkehrende Steuerungsarbeit mit KI, etwa Commit-Zusammenfassungen, Pipeline-Checks oder Deal Reviews, gemeinsam mit unserem AI & Automation Team

Dein Profil

title: Supply and Demand Planner
description:
The Role

At HelloConnect, you will be part of a dynamic team in Inoza Tower, BGC that embraces innovation and leverages advanced technology to create exceptional experiences. Our culture is built on collaboration, continuous learning, and a commitment to excellence. You’ll have the opportunity to work on impactful projects, develop your skills, and grow within a supportive environment that values diverse perspectives and experiences.

In this role, you will take on a key responsibility in getting the right products to our members at the right time. You’ll own our robust short and long-range forecasts and demand plans, bringing together seasonal patterns, customer trends and upcoming marketing activity to determine optimal purchasing volumes across all of our product types.

You’ll build the long-term view of our monthly themes, finding smart ways to put excess legacy kits and theme stock to good use where appropriate. From there, you’ll break that plan down into full theme forecasts and fortnightly production plans, agreed with our 3PL partner.

You’ll also be the go-to person for stock reporting, reconciling our internal view of stock against supplier stock levels, taking into account both regular reporting and every stock movement, so the business always has an accurate picture.

Great communication is key to success in this role. You’ll work closely with your own team and the wider business, bringing data to life through clear, visual reporting that gives everyone complete transparency.

Working alongside our Supply Chain Director and Operations Manager, you’ll have the opportunity to shape how we plan, driving improvements in forecasting accuracy and building processes that reduce excess stock and risk. Contributing to our ongoing efforts to drive business success and enhance customer satisfaction.

We’re looking for passionate individuals who can bring their unique skills and ideas to the table. Even if you don't meet every requirement but believe you’d excel in this role, we’d love to hear from you!

 

What you’ll do

Planning & Forecasting:

• Taking account of current and future stock, create and implement short, full-theme and long- range forecasts and demand plans.

• Collaborate with the marketing team to understand their plans and objectives and reflect these in forecasting.

• Partner with the Head Buyers to drive commercial opportunities through the strategic timing of themes, and to ensure consistent stock availability for retail opportunities and permanent listings with key partners.

• Calculate and submit purchasing volumes for subscription and shop through a defined S&OP process, using available technology to improve accuracy, and work with the Supply Chain. Director to ensure a smooth sign-off.

• Report on overall stock levels, weekly progress on reducing excess and short-dated stock, and upcoming risks and priorities.

• Work with marketing, the Operations Manager and the Supply Chain Director to clear short-dated stock, including promotional packs and shop activity, so that every short-dated item has a plan and no expired product is used.

• Work with our 3PL to plan and direct production, minimizing delays to order dispatch. 

• Work with the wider team to plan brew and drawdown schedules for Welcome Box beer and wine, and to ensure consistent availability of non-core items such as packaging, magazines and snacks.

• Identify opportunities to sell surplus stock through other Beer52 channels.

• Work with the Supply Chain Director and Operations Manager to deliver peak forecasts and forward plans that manage volume increases.

• Develop robust processes and tools that promote good practice and continuous improvement.

3PL Supervision:

• Share forecasts as appropriate to allow for efficient production planning.

• Maintain an internal stock tracking system and carry out regular data quality checks to hold the 3PL to account and ensure FIFO/FEFO is followed.

title: Director of SEC Reporting and Technical Accounting
description:
Thanks for your interest in Oklo! We are searching for a Director of SEC Reporting and Technical Accounting to join our growing team.

Position Description:

The Director of SEC Reporting and Technical Accounting will own the preparation of Oklo’s annual and quarterly financial statement and oversee all technical accounting-related analyses and memos. Reporting to the VP of Accounting and Controller, this role will also oversee the development of Oklo’s suite of accounting policies and SOX controls as the Company expands its operations. The Director will work closely with the internal audit department and be a primary contact for the Company’s external auditors. The role will also be a key partner to peers within Oklo’s finance team and across the organization, providing internal training and education on areas of accounting impacting Oklo today and in the future. This role will be a key resource to Corporate Development, Procurement and Business Unit Leaders, providing expert accounting advice as contracts and other transactions are being structured. The Director will play a critical role in optimizing Oklo’s accounting processes, policies and reporting, enabling the business to grow at pace.

Specific responsibilities may include:

• Prepare the financial statements and footnotes for Oklo’s Form 10-K and Form 10-Q, including all supporting schedules, and related reporting packages. Partner with key stakeholders across the Company to prepare the MD&A.

• Lead Disclosure Committee meetings and assist the VP of Accounting and Controller in the preparation of Audit Committee reports.

• Lead monthly internal calls with Oklo’s finance team and the external auditors on the accounting for significant new transactions, and related disclosure considerations.

• Perform technical accounting research on complex areas of accounting relevant to Oklo, including business combinations and asset acquisitions, power purchase agreements, consolidation and equity method accounting, financial investments, stock-based compensation, and capitalization of construction costs.

• Lead the adoption of any new Accounting Standards and Accounting Standard Updates, including project management and reporting progress to senior management. Monitor developments at the FASB as it relates to potential new standards,

• Serve as key contact for the Company’s external auditors, ensuring strong project management over all phases of the audit and identifying any areas for continuous improvement.

• Own the Company’s suite of accounting policies and lead the development of new policies as the Company expands and new business transactions are executed.

• Own SOX controls in the areas of SEC reporting and technical accounting, preparing robust documentation to support ICFR certifications and the external SOX audit.

• Coach and develop the team, identify appropriate training and development opportunities for each team member, and lead organization-wide training on key accounting and reporting topics.

• Monitor developments at the SEC and any rule changes that may impact Oklo’s filing requirements. Partner with Legal and Compliance on all SEC-reporting matters.

• Develop accounting playbooks to educate and support the organization on key areas of accounting impacting Oklo.

• Identify opportunities to improve financial reporting processes, workpapers, and controls to increase accuracy, efficiency, and scalability.

• Partner with the Process and Systems team to identify AI implementation opportunities that would enhance Oklo’s financial reporting and technical accounting functions.

• Partner with Accounting Operations to ensure transactions are accounted for accurately and in a timely manner and G/L architecture is optimally designed to streamline SEC reporting.

• Partner with the FP&A team to ensure internal forecasts accurately reflect the accounting for significant new transactions.

title: Regional Sales Manager, North America
description:
Sell Sweetspot to golf venues across North America, then stay with them as their main contact for the long run. Full-cycle sales and account ownership in one role, as one of our first hires in North America.
About Sweetspot
We make golf more valuable - to the player who shows up, the operator who runs the venue, and the game itself. It's the test we hold everything we build to.
Sweetspot is the commercial platform for modern golf facilities: bookings, payments, memberships, dynamic pricing, POS, the player app, revenue management agents and the reporting that finally tells an operator what all of it earns. We build for the facility because that's where golf actually happens. When a venue knows its players, it can give every one of them a reason to come back, and that's how the game grows. Golf will never be worth enough, so we'll never be done.
500+ facilities in 20 countries, built in Sweden - and North America is where we're growing fastest. This is one of the first hires on the ground, so you won't inherit a playbook. You'll write it with us, and every venue you sign is one more place where golf is worth more than it was the year before.
The opportunity
Most range and simulator operators here can't answer the question their business rests on: what is an hour of bay time worth, and when? They price the same bucket at 7am Tuesday as at 6pm Friday. They don't know which bays sit cold or which members quietly stopped coming. The data exists - it's just scattered across a booking tool, a POS, a Toptracer bay and somebody's spreadsheet, none of which talk.
We put it in one place and then do something with it: pricing that fills the cold hours, memberships that make revenue forecastable, utilization and yield reported per bay and per hour. It isn't a software sale. You show an owner what their venue could earn, then stay and make it happen.
What we believe about the relationship
Golf is a small industry and it runs on people. An operator who bought from you does not want to be handed to a stranger the week after go-live - so we don't do that. You keep your customers. You sign them, you see them through the switch, and you're still the name in their phone two years later when they're opening a second site.
That's a deliberate choice. It costs more per rep and it means we hire people who can do both halves of the job. It's also why our customers stay, and why they take our call when we have something new to sell them.
The job

• Find the opportunities. Roughly 70% of your week. Your own pipeline, your own demos, your own closes. Nobody hands you leads.

• Own the partner relationships. Toptracer and Range Servant are how much of this market gets built. Be the person their people in your territory actually call - joint visits, shared prospects, and enough standing with them to open doors we'd never open cold. This is your path to high velocity from Day 1.

• Get customers through the transition. Switching systems is the scariest thing an operator does all year. You own the commercial side of go-live and you train their team yourself. Our Support team takes configuration, migration and the ticket queue, so your time goes into the relationship.

• Don't be a stranger. Regular contact, on site, with their numbers in hand - what's underpriced, which hours are cold, which members drifted. Show up before they need you, not after.

• Sell the whole portfolio. Then come back and grow them: memberships, dynamic pricing, vouchers, POS, Pay & Dispense, the app, the second site. Expansion sits in your number, not somebody else's.

Who you are

• Well-connected in golf where you live. Range owners, simulator operators, academy directors - by first name.

• A closer. Full-cycle B2B with multiple stakeholders and an install at the end.

• Comfortable in the numbers. You can build the payback case in front of an owner and defend it without a spreadsheet to hide behind.

• Someone who wants to own customers, not just deals. You'd rather have twenty o

title: Product Manager, Impact Platform & Experimentation
description:
Brief info about Vinted 

Our mission is to make second-hand the first choice, and we're looking for people who want to help us get there. Every day, we work together to help our members buy and sell pre-loved clothing and lifestyle items, giving each piece a second life - or even a third.
The Vinted Group is made up of three business units that support this mission:

Vinted Marketplace is Europe’s leading platform for second-hand fashion and a go-to destination for all kinds of pre-loved items, with a growing range of categories. Our platform connects millions of members across 20+ markets, helping great items find a new life.

Vinted Go enhances the shipping experience with a vast network of over 500,000 pick-up and drop-off points, partnering with more than 60 carriers across Europe, with added services like item verification for peace of mind on high-value pieces.

Vinted Pay is the newest part of the Vinted Group, dedicated to bringing secure, reliable payments to buyers and sellers across Europe. Seamlessly integrated into the Vinted app, it helps keep every transaction safe, efficient, and easy for our members.

Founded in 2008 in Lithuania, Vinted began as a way for friends to find new homes for clothes they no longer needed. In 2019, we became Lithuania's first unicorn! Today, our headquarters remain in Vilnius, and we've grown with offices across Europe, supported by a team of over 2,000 people. 

Information about the position 

Join the Experimentation & Impact Platform at Vinted. We are two closely linked teams in Data Infrastructure that build the internal products Vinted uses to ship features safely and make decisions based on evidence. Teams across Marketplace, Vinted Go and Vinted Pay use our tools. Product, Engineering, Data and Design people use them every day to roll out features, run experiments and understand impact.

• Impact Platform builds Impact, our self-service feature-flag and experimentation platform. That includes SDKs for Ruby, JavaScript, Go, iOS and Android, the backend services, and the Impact web UI. Impact handles about 20 million flag evaluations per second.

• Experimentation builds the standardised metrics framework and automated experiment analysis pipelines. It also owns cumulative impact reporting, which tracks the observed effect of shipped work across 17 key business metrics and feeds into Marketplace planning. The team also creates educational material and helps with complex analysis cases.

As the Product Manager for both teams, you'll own one shared product backlog. It covers feature flagging, experiment setup, metric standardisation, analysis automation and impact reporting. Your work won't affect just one product area. It shapes how the whole company learns and decides. Our vision: no decision at Vinted, large or small, is made without solid experimental evidence behind it. Join us in making sustainable consumption the first choice worldwide.

In this position, you’ll 

• Own the needs of our internal users: engineers, product managers, designers, decision scientists and analysts, and leadership. Talk to them regularly to understand their pain points with feature flags, experiment setup, metrics and results, so the right workflow is the easy one.

• Work with engineers (data, backend and web), data scientists and our Product Designer to shape and deliver a roadmap that makes experiments faster to set up, results more trustworthy and quicker to arrive, and learnings easier to find.

• Own and prioritise one backlog across two teams. Balance new capabilities with platform reliability, migration work and tech debt, and choose high-value, low-effort solutions where you can.

• Define and track product success with metrics such as experiment volume and validity, conclusive experiment rate, time to set up an experiment, experiment duration and platform adoption.

• Run our feedback loop, including the public roadmap, the request intake and support flow, survey

COMPANY OVERVIEW

Deepgram is the leading platform underpinning the emerging trillion-dollar Voice AI economy, providing real-time APIs for speech-to-text (STT), text-to-speech (TTS), and building production-grade voice agents at scale. More than 200,000 developers and 1,300+ organizations build voice offerings that are ‘Powered by Deepgram’, including Twilio, Cloudflare, Sierra, Decagon, Vapi, Daily, Cresta, Granola, and Jack in the Box. Deepgram’s voice-native foundation models are accessed through cloud APIs or as self-hosted and on-premises software, with unmatched accuracy, low latency, and cost efficiency. Backed by a recent Series C led by leading global investors and strategic partners, Deepgram has processed over 50,000 years of audio and transcribed more than 1 trillion words. There is no organization in the world that understands voice better than Deepgram.

COMPANY OPERATING RHYTHM

At Deepgram, we expect an AI-first mindset-AI use and comfort aren’t optional, they’re core to how we operate, innovate, and measure performance.

Every team member who works at Deepgram is expected to actively use and experiment with advanced AI tools, and even build your own into your everyday work. We measure how effectively AI is applied to deliver results, and consistent, creative use of the latest AI capabilities is key to success here. Candidates should be comfortable adopting new models and modes quickly, integrating AI into their workflows, and continuously pushing the boundaries of what these technologies can do.

Additionally, we move at the pace of AI. Change is rapid, and you can expect your day-to-day work to evolve just as quickly. This may not be the right role if you’re not excited to experiment, adapt, think on your feet, and learn constantly, or if you’re seeking something highly prescriptive with a traditional 9-to-5.

Deepgram is hiring a Senior Manager, Deal Desk to build our deal desk from the ground up and run it. Deepgram is a usage-based voice AI platform (speech-to-text, text-to-speech and the Voice Agent API), sold through self-serve plans, enterprise commitments and cloud marketplaces. You'll report to the Chief Accounting Officer and work daily with leaders in Sales, Customer Success, Product and Finance.

The desk is not a control function. Its job is to help Sales win better deals faster, at prices we can defend.

What you'll do

- Build the desk: approval matrix, pre-approved playbook, and credit and promo guidelines, so most deals need no approval.

- Run it day to day: review non-standard deals and give same-day answers.

- Shape large deals early: commitment size, ramps, product mix and terms.

- Partner with Product and sales leadership on pricing and packaging.

- Build pricing insight: deal margin, realized discount, and win rate by discount band.

- Keep deals clean and audit-ready, with approvals and terms recorded in Salesforce.

- Use AI to run the desk: an agent does the first-pass review; you make the call and improve the rules.

- Build out CPQ in Salesforce so the playbook and approvals live in the quote.

- Partner with Customer Success on renewals at first, then take ownership of renewals as the desk matures.

What you'll need

- 6+ years in deal desk, deal strategy or pricing at a B2B technology company, with 3+ running a desk.

- Usage-based pricing experience: commitments, credits, overage, ramps and rollover.

- A desk, matrix or playbook you built that sales adopted.

- Financial fluency, including how deal terms affect revenue recognition.

- Hands-on experience building Salesforce CPQ, plus SQL.

- Credibility with sales executives, clear writing, and an AI-native way of working you can show.

Nice to have

- Infrastructure, API or AI company experience.

- Pre-IPO experience.

- Cloud marketplace private offers (AWS, GCP, Azure).

- Has owned or run renewals.

We value initiative, clarity and execution, creating space for ambitious people to build systems that support millions of businesses worldwide. Here, innovation thrives, ideas are celebrated and people come first, no matter where they call home.

Our impact
Every month, HighLevel enables more than 1.5 billion messages, 200 million leads and 20 million conversations for the more than 1 million businesses we support. Behind those numbers are real people building independence, expanding opportunity and creating measurable impact. We’re proud to be a part of that.
Learn more about us on our YouTube Channel or Blog Posts

About the Team:

The Email team owns the Email platform behind HighLevel 's email experience, which powers 40M+ emails a day. We own the full path from compose to inbox, so the reliability, speed and quality of what we ship directly decide whether emails from over a million businesses land in the inbox.

We are responsible for:

• Email Platform: The Vue.js apps used to design, compose and send emails, plus the Node.js/NestJS services behind them.

• Sending Infrastructure & Deliverability: IP pools, dedicated IPs, dedicated domains and shared domain pools. These let new users send from day one, while we stay accountable for getting their email into the inbox.

• API-First Platform: Every capability is exposed through APIs, so email can be built into any product or workflow that needs it.

• Scale & Reliability: Keeping throughput high at peak load, with high uptime and send success rates.

• Email Statistics & Analytics: Integrating email stats with internal teams and making every release measurable on our dashboards.

• AI in Email: Bringing LLM-powered capabilities into email creation, while weighing token cost, latency and quality

Impact & Scale

Email is one of the most critical channels on HighLevel . When it works, businesses grow; when it breaks, their customers stop hearing from them. That's the weight this role carries.

• Businesses: Every one of the 1M+ businesses on HighLevel relies on email to reach their customers.

• Sub-accounts: Your work runs across 1.6M+ sub-accounts, from solo operators to agencies managing hundreds of clients.

• End users: What you ship reaches end users through 1.2B+ emails every month.

• Volume: 40M+ emails a day flow through the systems you'll own, so a 1% gain in reliability or deliverability affects hundreds of thousands of emails daily.

• Blast radius: One change can affect every business on the platform at once, which is why we care so much about reliability, data integrity and security.

How we work

• Iterate fast: Go from idea to prototype to production in days, not quarters. Ship small, measure, learn and improve.

• Use AI well: Use AI across the whole cycle (design, coding, testing, reviews and debugging) to move faster without lowering the quality bar, and pick the right model for each job based on quality, latency and cost.

THE ROLE

You'll own the integration architecture that connects our core HRIS to our wider technology stack, while building the AI-native capabilities that make it easier for employees, managers and the People team to get things done.

You will build the hard pieces yourself, and make HRIS data and workflows usable by agents, automations, and MCP servers, creating new ways of interacting with People technology.

This is a senior, hands-on individual contributor role for someone who combines deep integration engineering expertise with a passion for emerging technology. You'll work closely with People Technology, IT, Security and functional stakeholders who rely on People data, balancing speed and innovation with reliability, security and scalability.

- AI & Intelligent Automation. Build the AI-native integration layer that enables employees, managers and the People team to interact with systems in new ways. Design and develop MCP servers, AI agents and intelligent workflows that securely access People data and execute actions across systems. Identify opportunities to eliminate manual work, enable self-service and bring People processes into the tools employees already use. Evaluate emerging AI capabilities and determine when to leverage existing platforms versus building custom solutions.

- Security, Reliability & Governance. Establish the technical controls that make our integrations and AI capabilities secure, observable and dependable. Define standards for authentication, field-level permissions, monitoring, alerting, error handling, retries, testing and auditability. Own the ongoing integration lifecycle, including release testing, documentation, troubleshooting and continuous improvement. Partner with IT, Security and Legal to protect sensitive People data and ensure responsible AI use.

- Technical Leadership & Engineering Excellence. Act as the technical authority for People

title: _ Expert General Ledger Accountant

This position plays a key role in ensuring the accuracy, integrity, and timely execution of General Ledger accounting activities, while contributing to risk management, process efficiency, and continuous improvement.

Beyond executing accounting activities, the successful candidate will be expected to work independently, anticipate challenges, identify improvement opportunities, and actively contribute to initiatives that strengthen financial operations.

The role requires close collaboration with regional and headquarters Finance teams, Tax, Legal, Systems, and other internal stakeholders.

About the Role

 

• Accounting, Budgeting & Tax Compliance: Lead best-in-class financial processes for the Hub entity, including budget/forecast monitoring, variance reporting, annual budgeting exercises, and coordination with external tax consultants for timely tax declarations, audits, and full regulatory compliance.

• General Ledger & Financial Control: Oversee GL accounting activities across all entities, ensuring accuracy, completeness, and adherence to corporate policies, accounting standards, and internal controls throughout monthly, quarterly, and annual closing cycles.

• Audit & Internal Controls Support: Support internal and external audits by providing accurate documentation, timely explanations, and ensuring compliance with established accounting procedures and control frameworks.

title: Partnerships Lead
description:
ABOUT US

Lorikeet is redefining what customer support looks like - and we're just getting started.

We build AI that handles complex, high-volume support for fintechs, healthtechs, marketplaces, and delivery services. Not chatbot-tier AI. The kind that actually resolves tickets, gives support teams their time back, and raises the bar for what software can do.

We're backed by over $50M USD from QED, Blackbird, and Square Peg, with backing from operators like Claire Hughes Johnson (ex-Stripe COO) and Cristina Cordova (Linear COO), plus founders of Canva, Atlassian, and Airwallex. We're the first company since Canva to be funded at early stage by all three of Australia's top VC funds - which tells you something about the calibre of people who've looked closely at what we're building and said yes.

Our customers include some of the largest telehealth, fintech, and marketplace companies in the US and Australia - many handling over a million support tickets a year. The problems are real, the scale is real, and the work matters.

If you want to build something that genuinely changes how businesses and customers interact - this is the place.

ABOUT THE ROLE

Partners already bring Lorikeet deals. Zendesk referrals, helpdesk and CCaaS platforms, and PE/VC portfolio networks have all brought us customers. But the program is still early: there's no tiering, no playbook, and no repeatable engine behind what's working. You'll turn those early wins into a partner channel that drives a real share of our pipeline, starting in the US and scaling across EMEA and APAC.

You'll report to our CRO and work closely with our AEs, Marketing and Forward Deployed teams. You'll own the partner program end to end, from design to signed partners to sourced revenue.

ABOUT YOU

You're a builder. You've stood up a partner program before, with tiers, terms, recruitment and attribution, at a company where nobody handed you a playbook. You have strong commercial instincts. You can tell a partner that will drive deals from one that just wants a logo swap, and you'd rather go deep with five good partners than collect fifty.

You have deep experience in partnerships, channel or alliances at B2B startups. AI or customer support and CX tech experience is a big plus. Partnering on AI products works differently from traditional SaaS, and knowing the helpdesk, CCaaS, SI and BPO landscape will get you moving faster.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Design the program. Define partner tiers across referral partners, helpdesk and CCaaS platforms, consultancies and SIs, and PE/VC portfolio networks. Set what each tier gets and owes: referral fees or margins, enablement, co-marketing and certification.

- Double down on what's working. Turn our Zendesk referral motion, platform partners and investor portfolio networks into repeatable channels. Build the data to show which partners add value, and wind down the ones that don't.

- Make marketplaces a growth lever. Own our presence on the Zendesk, Salesforce and HubSpot marketplaces, including listings, reviews and co-marketing, so buyers find Lorikeet where they already shop for support tools.

- Co-sell with our AEs. Set the rules of engagement for deal registration, account mapping and handoffs, so partner deals speed up our sales cycle instead of slowing it down.

- Build the engine and own the number. Stand up the playbook, contracts, enablement kit and CRM attribution. Own a partner-sourced pipeline target of $2M-$3M in your first 12 months, and report on it to leadership every month.

YOU MIGHT BE A FIT IF YOU:

- Bring 5+ years in partnerships, channel or alliances at B2B SaaS companies, including at least 2 years owning a partner program or a partner-sourced revenue target

- Have built a partnerships program from the ground up

- Thrive at early-stage companies, and would rather build the system yourself than inherit a big partner team at an established software company

- Know the customer support ecosystem, including helpdesks,

title: Driver Recruiter
locationText: Bosnia and Herzegovina, North Macedonia, Serbia, Ukraine
description:
This position will manage CDL Class A driver recruitment, screening, and onboarding for company drivers and owner-operators while supporting driver relations and maintaining current compliance documentation. The ideal candidate has experience working for an asset-based trucking company, communicates effectively with drivers, and handles concerns calmly and professionally.

Key responsibilities
Driver recruitment and onboarding

• Recruit and screen CDL Class A drivers.

• Conduct initial interviews and assess driving experience, qualifications, and suitability for the role.

• Coordinate candidate follow-ups, interviews, and hiring steps with management.

• Coordinate pre-employment checks.

• Coordinate the onboarding process for company drivers and owner-operators, ensuring all required documentation and approvals are completed.

• Organize driver orientation and coordinate with operations to prepare new drivers for their start.

Driver relations

• Build positive relationships with drivers and serve as a reliable point of contact.

• Respond promptly to driver questions, complaints, and concerns.

• Handle difficult conversations calmly, de-escalate tense situations, and coordinate practical solutions.

• Follow up on unresolved issues and keep drivers and management informed.

Compliance and documentation

• Maintain accurate and organized driver qualification files.

• Track CDL validity, medical certification, and other required driver documentation.

• Obtain, review, and maintain Motor Vehicle Records (MVR) and Pre-Employment Screening Program (PSP) reports as applicable.

• Monitor document expiration dates, send reminders, and follow up on renewals.

• Track and coordinate updates to occupational accident coverage (OAC) and related insurance documentation, as applicable.

• Communicate outstanding compliance items to drivers and management.

• Coordinate with operations to resolve issues affecting driver readiness and availability.

Working conditions:

• Work schedule: Mon-Fri 8 am - 5 pm OR 9 am - 6 pm EST

• Competitive Salary in USD

• Remote mode of work

• 10+ business days of paid time off

• Team building and corporate events

• Equipment provided

• A supportive team

Requirements
Required experience and skills

• Previous experience working for an asset-based trucking or transportation company.

• Experience recruiting, screening, and onboarding CDL Class A drivers, including company drivers and owner-operators.

• Experience communicating directly with drivers and managing driver relations.

• Basic knowledge of trucking and logistics operations.

• Working knowledge of driver qualification files and compliance documentation, including CDLs, medical certification, MVRs, and PSP reports.

• Familiarity with occupational accident coverage and related documentation.

• Strong interviewing, listening, problem-solving, and conflict-resolution skills.

• Ability to remain calm and professional during challenging conversations.

• Strong organization, attention to detail, and consistent follow-through.

- Experience building identity, security, authentication, or authorization services.

- Familiarity with IAM challenges for AI agents, MCP clients or servers, or service-to-service systems.

- Experience with database systems, query engines, or database internals.

- Experience operating highly available, scalable cloud services.

- Graduate-level study in Computer Science or a related technical field.

WHY JOIN THE IDENTITY & ACCESS MANAGEMENT TEAM AT SNOWFLAKE?

IAM is central to how customers protect their data and adopt new capabilities securely. You will work on systems that directly shape the security, reliability, and usability of Snowflake, while contributing to emerging areas such as agent identity and AI access
